scripts.postinstall: node -e "const p=require('path');const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const pnpmDir=p.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','.pnpm');if(!fs.existsSync(pnpmDir)){console.warn('[abonnieren] .pnpm folder not found; skipping vue-demi switch');process.exit(0);}const match=fs.readdirSync(pnpmDir).find((d)=>d.startsWith('vue-demi@'));if(!match){console.warn('[abonnieren] vue-demi package not found; skipping switch');process.exit(0);}const sw=p.join(pnpmDir,match,'node_modules','vue-demi','bin','vue-demi-switch.js');if(!fs.existsSync(sw)){console.warn('[abonnieren] vue-demi switch script not found');process.exit(0);}cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,[sw,'2.7'],{stdio:'inherit'});"
